_comment: OpenClaw user config for the MedicalHarness study (harness.yaml user_config). The harness-bench openclaw
adapter rewrites models.providers.vllm.baseUrl to the usage proxy at episode start. Replace __VLLM_PORT__.
maxTokens 65536: the default 16k output cap truncated tool calls and zeroed 15/32 calc tasks before it was raised.
timeoutSeconds 1800: uniform request timeout across every harness in the study.
The harness.yaml entry carries timeout_sec 3600 (the harness value wins over task.yaml); the original 900s
wall clock timed out 6/32 calc tasks.
browser: OpenClaw drives the study's headless Chrome through CDP with its NATIVE browser tool. attachOnly
means it never launches its own browser; evaluateEnabled=false is the JavaScript ban that the MCP rows
enforce with mcp_browser_no_js.py (upstream healthadmin declares javascript: false); ssrfPolicy must admit
loopback or the portal on 127.0.0.1:3002 is refused. Per-slot copies differ only in cdpUrl.
Stated caveat for the healthadmin column: OpenClaw is the ONLY harness on its own browser; the other five
share one Playwright MCP. The OpenClaw-vs-rest gap on that column mixes 'native vs generic browser' in.
memory.search.remote is an OpenClaw default that names an embedding model; with the study model it is
never reached. Invocation: openclaw agent --local --model vllm/qwen36-35b-a3b-260k.
